headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 19, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a dominant 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, led by José Ramírez's impressive performance at the plate. Ramírez hit 3 hits, including his 8th home run of the season. In other action, the Tampa Bay Rays routed the Baltimore Orioles 16-6, while the Miami Marlins dominated the Atlanta Braves 12-0.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Lance McCullers Jr. has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation, retroactive to May 16, 2026. Other injured players include James McCann (strained right quad), Joe Mantiply (left knee inflammation), Clay Holmes (right fibula fracture), Garrett Acton (right shoulder strain), Ryan Jeffers (left hamate bone fracture), Drake Baldwin (strained right oblique muscle), and Jordan Beck (left hamstring strain).

The MLB trade market has been active, with several notable moves. The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired Eric Lauer from the Toronto Blue Jays for cash, while the Chicago White Sox traded for Junior Perez from the Athletics. The Athletics also traded Kyle Robinson to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Alika Williams and Eduarniel Núñez to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured an 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, led by José Ramírez's impressive performance at the plate. Ramírez hit 3 hits, including his 8th home run of the season, a fly ball to left field.

top_news.title: **Rays Rout Orioles 16-6**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 16-6 victory. Junior Caminero led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Phillies in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a close game to the Philadelphia Phillies, losing 4-5. Bryson Stott led the Phillies' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Rout Braves 12-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Atlanta Braves, securing a 12-0 victory behind a strong performance from Max Meyer. Javier Sanoja led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Take Down Marlins 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured an 8-4 victory over the Miami Marlins, with multiple players contributing to the win. Mauricio Dubón, Matt Olson, and Michael Harris II were among the impact hitters for the Braves.

top_news.title: **Astros Place Lance McCullers Jr. on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Lance McCullers Jr. has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. The move is retroactive to May 16, 2026.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire LHP Eric Lauer in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer in a trade. Lauer joins the Dodgers after being traded from the Toronto Blue Jays for cash.
